settings.section-volume.subtitle: How the volume keys change your loudness, and how far each press moves it. Both modes swallow the keys and show your own OSD; they differ in what the keys actually change.
settings.eapo-switch-mode.label: Switch to Windows volume mode
settings.system-mode.title: Replace Windows volume
settings.system-mode.subtitle: The keys move the normal Windows volume. Any Equalizer APO EQ you have set is left untouched.
settings.eapo-mode.title: Equalizer APO preamp slider
settings.eapo-mode.subtitle: The keys write Equalizer APO's preamp, attenuating before your EQ. Requires Equalizer APO.
settings.step.title: Volume key step size
settings.step.subtitle: How many percent one press of a volume key moves.
settings.device-volume.title: Per-device volume
settings.tray-left-click.title: Click the tray icon
settings.tray-left-click.subtitle: What a left click does. Right click always opens the menu.
settings.tray-middle-click.title: Middle-click the tray icon
settings.tray-middle-click.subtitle: What the mouse wheel button does when pressed on the icon.
settings.tray-scroll.title: Scroll to adjust volume
settings.tray-scroll.subtitle: Roll the wheel over the tray icon — or over a HUD volume widget — to change the volume, the way the Windows volume icon works. Hold Ctrl for 1% steps, Shift for 10%.
settings.scroll-inverted.title: Invert scroll direction
settings.scroll-inverted.subtitle: Scroll down to raise the volume instead of lowering it.
settings.autostart.title: Start with Windows
settings.autostart.subtitle: Launch AorinEQ automatically when you sign in.
settings.elevation-state.title: Run as administrator
settings.elevation-state.subtitle: Required for the volume keys to work while elevated games are focused.
settings.eapo-health-heading.heading: Equalizer APO health
settings.text.switched-on-for-the: Switched on for the device you're using
settings.setup-guide.label: Setup guide
settings.open-configurator.label: Configurator
settings.repair-eapo.label: Repair automatically
settings.undo-repair.label: Undo repair
settings.section-osd.subtitle: The overlay that appears when you press a volume key.
settings.style.title: Style
settings.style.subtitle: Pick a built-in look, or your own skin.
settings.anchor-top-left.title: Position
settings.anchor-top-left.subtitle: Which screen edge or corner the OSD is anchored to.
settings.offset-x.title: Offset
settings.offset-x.subtitle: Nudge the OSD away from its anchor, in pixels.
settings.hide-delay.title: Hide delay
settings.animation-check.title: Animate fade-out
settings.animation-check.subtitle: Fade the OSD away instead of hiding it instantly.
settings.animation-duration.title: Animation duration
settings.section-hud.subtitle: Small always-on-top panels showing your own audio: the spectrum after your EQ, your output levels and clipping, your EQ curve, and your volume. They stay out of your way — never in Alt+Tab, never focused, and click-through unless you are arranging them.
settings.hud-edit-switch.title: Arrange widgets
settings.hud-edit-switch.subtitle: On: widgets can be dragged, resized and right-clicked for their own settings. Off: they are completely click-through, so a click over one reaches whatever is underneath.
settings.add-spectrum.title: Add a widget
settings.add-spectrum.subtitle: A new widget appears on your main screen, ready to drag into place.
settings.add-spectrum.label: Spectrum
settings.add-levels.label: Levels
settings.add-eq-curve.label: EQ curve
settings.add-volume.label: Volume
settings.hud-empty.subtitle: No widgets yet.
settings.hud-fullscreen-switch.title: Hide while a fullscreen app is in front
settings.hud-fullscreen-switch.subtitle: Overlays over exclusive-fullscreen games either flicker or do not draw at all, so hiding them is better than showing them badly.
settings.hud-only-playing-switch.title: Show only while audio is playing
settings.hud-only-playing-switch.subtitl: The widgets appear when sound starts and fade out a few seconds after it stops.
settings.hud-fps.title: Refresh rate
settings.hud-fps.subtitle: How often every widget redraws. One timer serves all of them; lower it if you would rather spend nothing at all on the HUD.
settings.section-skins.subtitle: Custom OSD artwork. Skins are folders of images — design your own, or install one someone shared.
settings.skin-credit.title: Active skin
settings.skin-credit.subtitle: Used when the OSD style is set to Custom skin.
settings.skin-designer.title: Manage skins
settings.skin-designer.subtitle: Design a new skin, install one shared as a zip, or open the folder they live in.
settings.skin-designer.label: Skin designer
settings.import-skin.label: Import…
settings.import-skin.tooltip: Install a skin shared as a zip file
settings.open-skins-folder.label: Folder
settings.rescan-skins.label: Rescan
settings.protocol-links.title: Enable aorineq:// links
settings.protocol-links.subtitle: Install shared skins and EQ presets straight from websites — always asks first.
settings.section-equalizer.subtitle: Per-device parametric EQ with presets, AutoEq profiles and live meters.
settings.open-equalizer.title: Equalizer editor
settings.open-equalizer.subtitle: Draggable curve, band strip, presets, AutoEq import and post-EQ meters.
settings.open-equalizer.label: Open equalizer
settings.section-air-play.subtitle: Stream this PC's audio to a HomePod, Apple TV or other AirPlay receiver. Experimental.
settings.air-play-status.title: Receiver
settings.air-play-status.subtitle: Not streaming.
settings.air-play-refresh.label: Refresh
settings.air-play-connect.label: Connect
settings.air-play-source.title: Source
settings.air-play-source.subtitle: Which playback device is captured and sent. Pick a virtual device to stream without your speakers also playing it.
settings.air-play-mode.title: Playback mode
settings.air-play-mode.subtitle: How much audio is queued ahead. Less delay means more chance of a dropout — watch the resend figure below.
settings.air-play-volume.title: Receiver volume
settings.air-play-volume.subtitle: The AirPlay device's own level. Set it to 100% and let the volume keys do the work.
settings.air-play-retarget-note.title: Volume keys drive the receiver
settings.air-play-retarget-note.subtitle: While streaming, the volume keys set the AirPlay device's level instead of Windows'.
settings.air-play-mute-local.title: Mute this PC while streaming
settings.air-play-mute-local.subtitle: Silences your speakers so the sound only comes from the receiver. Unreliable on some DACs — it can mute the stream too. Choosing a virtual device as the source above is the dependable way.
settings.air-play-dither.title: Dithered silence
settings.air-play-dither.subtitle: Sends an inaudible noise floor instead of digital silence, so the receiver's output stage does not sleep and clip the first instant of the next track.
settings.air-play-idle-seconds.title: Stay connected when nothing is playing
settings.air-play-idle-seconds.subtitle: Keeps the session open through silence, so playback resumes instantly. Turn it off to hang up after a period of quiet.
settings.section-air-play.title: Session details
settings.section-air-play.subtitle-2: What is actually going over the wire.
settings.section-updates.subtitle: AorinEQ updates itself in place from its GitHub releases.
settings.auto-update.title: Keep AorinEQ up to date
settings.auto-update.subtitle: Check for a new version at startup and once a day, and install it automatically.
settings.update-status.title: Check for updates
settings.check-updates.label: Check now

onboarding.text.volume-keys-change-the: Volume keys change the normal Windows volume and show your skinned OSD instead of the Windows one. Using Equalizer APO for EQ/PEQ? Your EQ is never touched — set it once, control loudness natively.
onboarding.text.volume-keys-write-equali: Volume keys write Equalizer APO's preamp; Windows volume stays parked. Attenuation happens inside the APO chain before your EQ — for setups where the Windows volume path is broken or you want pre-DAC level control. Requires Equalizer APO.
onboarding.auto-update.label: Keep AorinEQ up to date automatically
onboarding.text.equalizer-apo-is-free: ·  Equalizer APO is free, open-source (GPLv2) software by Jonas Thedering.
